source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules 1.34: Figments, the Visualizer and the Rigger (Classes 3.0 step 8; docs/design/figments-spec.md). Every number PROVISIONAL (spec section 14, items 2100 to 2199).

visualizer.text: The Visualizer holds one mana core of its own (charge). Making a Figment and acting through one need it in a hand; held Figments stay while it is carried. Projection range: range.base + your Visualization tiles (range.no_door for a Rigger without the door).

level.note: A Figment's level-1 numbers grow by the enemy table at its owner's level (enemies.json levels): HP by hp_mult (rules 1.36: the column carries the level scale) x the maker's Visualization through the profile level.hp_stat names (output.profiles.figment_hp), Defense by defense_plus, armour by armour_mult. Its damage grows only by output.level.deal (the figment profile), never by skill.

limits.note: At most 4 Figments held (the Rigger at Visualization 7), plus the Rigger's Double and one Scrap Sentinel: 6 owned units a character.

upkeep.text: At your turn start: n charge for each Figment held; holding ap_from or more also costs ap AP that turn. Short of charge, the newest unravels for each charge missing.

let_go.text: Let go (verbs.let_go): unmake one; refund_share of its made charge (rounded down) goes back into the core. A Figment destroyed by damage gives nothing back and Snaps: your next turn has snap_ap AP less (at most once a turn).

forms_known.note: Rules 1.70 item 5541: forms are learned, never opened by a level or a fork. From the first point of Visualization, the forms you know: one more than your Visualization, at most all ten (2 at 1, all ten at 9), each chosen once (door/pick at the door figment_forms) and kept for good.

ladder.text: The door: Picture, with the forms you know; 1 held, range 5; Glimmer, Redraw and Cash in. The Visualizer also works out of a fight.

migration.note: Rev 1 (rules 1.56, Figments 2.0): a character made before the forks keeps every form the old ladder opened at its Visualization (legacy). Rev 2 (rules 1.70 item 5541): forms are learned at the door figment_forms; a save keeps every form it had open (the old ladder's fixed forms by points, fixed_before; its picks and kept forms at the old door; the legacy forms when it had no stamp) and counts them against its forms known; a form over the count is kept outside it, never lost.

lure.text: A Double lures by the fire doctrine of enemies.json (double_save): a tier with none is always fooled; the others save (Brain, against 12 + your Visualization strength, plus the tier's double_save) on first sight, an Elite and a Boss again at each of their turn starts, a Boss never two rounds running. An enemy that found a Double out gets found_out_add against your later Doubles this fight.

unit_effects.text: What every Figment is: no saves, immune to every condition (the Body, Brain and Heart families), to Bleeding and to Hidden (it never hides: Shadow is a character's). Each form's verb item (fig_<form>, collect.ts) holds these and its own.

forms.name: Double
forms.text: A second you, built of mana: {=hp} HP, your Defense, your pace. It draws fire: Minions and Vermin always take it for you; Soldiers, Elites and Bosses make a Brain save. Draw fire: every enemy that can see it close by makes a Heart save or is Taunted by it.

forms.name: Eye

scouts.about: rules 1.90 item 7812 (Leon, 20 Nov 2026): before a fight node's choice, a character who knows this form and could picture it now (the Visualizer carried, the form's charge in its loaded charge; nothing is spent) sends it ahead: the line-up is shown and this is the squad's ambush bonus (run/ambush.ts; the best scout counts)

forms.short: Flying eye: {=hp} HP · sees {=vision} tiles, in the dark, for your side · Stare keeps a foe seen
forms.text: A floating eye: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, {=movement} tiles an AP, flying. It sees {=vision} tiles, in the dark too, for your whole side. Stare: one unit it sees stays seen by your side until your next turn, Hidden or not. Before a fight it can go ahead (when you could picture it, nothing spent): the squad sees who is waiting, and its ambush roll takes +{=scouts.bonus}.

forms.name: Wall
forms.short: Movable full cover: {=hp} HP, armour {=armour} · blocks moves and sight · Press shoves a foe
forms.text: Movable cover: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, armour {=armour}, {=movement} tile an AP. Full cover; it blocks movement and sight for both sides and nothing pushes it. Press: it shoves an enemy next to it away.

forms.name: Beast
forms.short: Fast striker: {=hp} HP, {=movement} tiles an AP · Pounce: a run and a strike that can knock Prone
forms.text: A fast striker: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, armour {=armour}, {=movement} tiles an AP. Strike is a melee attack with its claws; Pounce runs a short straight line and strikes, and a hit knocks the target Prone unless it passes a Body save.

forms.name: Blade
forms.short: Floating blade: {=hp} HP · Cuts a foe beside it · Hold: Cuts the first foe a round to pass it
forms.text: A floating blade: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, {=movement} tiles an AP. Cut strikes an enemy next to it. Hold: the first enemy each round to enter or leave a tile next to it is Cut, and that spends one of your reactions.

forms.name: Snare
forms.text: A trap of mana: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, {=movement} tile an AP. Hold: the first enemy each round to enter or leave a tile next to it is Cut (one of your reactions). Trip: it Cuts an enemy next to it now. Its hit Pins the target (Body save) and the Snare is spent.

forms.name: Hand
forms.text: A courier of mana: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, {=movement} tiles an AP, flying. Hand over: it gives one of your own stims to an ally next to it. Filch: it lifts a throwable (else a spare magazine) from an enemy next to it onto its tile (a Body save keeps it).

forms.name: Ward
forms.short: Bodyguard: {=hp} HP · takes {=effects.0.share|pct}% of the first hit a round on an ally beside it
forms.text: A bodyguard: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, armour {=armour}, {=movement} tiles an AP. The first hit each round on an ally next to it lands {=effects.0.share|pct}% of it on the Ward. Interpose: it steps to a free tile next to an ally.

forms.name: Husk
forms.short: A hollow second you: {=hp} HP · lures like a Double · Bursts on everyone beside it
forms.text: A hollow second you: {=hp} HP, your Defense, your pace. It lures as a Double does. Burst: it bursts on everyone next to it, both sides, and is gone (no charge back, no Snap).

forms.name: Sentinel
forms.short: Mana turret: {=hp} HP, armour {=armour}, sees {=vision} tiles · Fixes the nearest foe each turn
forms.text: A turret of mana: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, armour {=armour}; it does not walk. It sees {=vision} tiles. At each of your turn starts it Fixes the nearest enemy on your AP; Fix: its shot now, at an enemy it sees.

turret.name: Scrap Turret
turret.text: A turret built from scrap: {=hp} HP, Defense {=defense}, armour {=armour}, it does not move. At each of your turn starts for {=rounds} rounds it makes its weapon's plain attack at the nearest enemy it can reach.

owner_uses.about: Rules 1.86 item 7410 (engine lane; the consolidation line, rule 4): the item uses an owned unit can run for its owner (a data verb's `use` names an actions.json row of one of these reducer types). Each is one engine door (owned.ts OWNER_USES: its handler, checked against this list as the engine loads); the validator holds `use` to these types.

verbs.name: Strike
verbs.text: A melee attack with the Figment's own weapon.

verbs.name: Pounce
verbs.text: Up to {=dash} tiles in a straight line, then a Strike; a hit knocks the target Prone (Body save).

verbs.name: Cut
verbs.text: A melee attack on an enemy next to it.

verbs.name: Stare
verbs.text: One unit it sees stays seen by your side until your next turn, Hidden or not.

verbs.name: Draw fire
verbs.text: Every enemy within {=effects.0.targets.within} tiles that can see it makes a Heart save or is Taunted by it for {=effects.0.rounds} round.

verbs.name: Press
verbs.text: It shoves an enemy next to it {=effects.0.tiles} tile away.

verbs.name: Trip
verbs.text: It Cuts an enemy next to it now.

verbs.name: Hand over
verbs.text: It gives one of your own stims to an ally next to it: the stim's own heal, or a Downed ally stabilised.

verbs.name: Filch
verbs.text: It lifts a throwable (else a spare magazine) from an enemy next to it onto its own tile; a Body save keeps it.

verbs.name: Interpose
verbs.text: It steps to a free tile next to an ally, within {=reach.tiles} tiles of it.

verbs.name: Burst
verbs.text: It bursts: {=amounts.burst.base} on every unit next to it, both sides, and it is gone (no charge back, no Snap).

verbs.name: Fix
verbs.text: Its shot now, at an enemy it sees within {=reach.tiles} tiles.

verbs.name: Redraw
verbs.text: It comes apart and reforms on a free tile within {=reach.tiles} tiles of it ({=res.vcharge} charge).

verbs.name: Cash in
verbs.text: Unmake it on purpose: all its made charge goes back into the core.

verbs.name: Let go
verbs.text: Unmake it: half its made charge (rounded down) goes back into the core.

traits.name: Swift
traits.text: +{=tiles} tiles an AP · its moves draw no opportunity attacks

traits.name: Loud
traits.text: Enemies treat it as the most hurt in reach

traits.name: Volatile
traits.text: Destroyed: {=amounts.burst.base} to everyone within {=within} tile, both sides

traits.name: Mirror
traits.text: Lures as any unit of your side you pick

traits.name: Keen
traits.text: +{=roll} to hit · an Eye sees {=vision} further

items.name: Picture
items.text: Costs {=effects.0.ap} AP and the form's charge (more for each trait) from your Visualizer. A Figment of a ready design or a bare form you have opened appears on a free tile your side sees within your projection range. Needs the Visualizer in hand.

items.name: Glimmer
items.text: Costs {=effects.0.ap} AP, no charge: the mana paints you in light on a free tile your side sees within your projection range. Every enemy that sees it is fooled as by a Double (Minions and Vermin always; Soldiers, Elites and Bosses make a Brain save) and takes it for you until it is struck or fades (at your turn start {=numbers.fade_rounds} rounds on). One false image of you at a time: a new one (a Double's too) replaces the old. Needs the Visualizer in hand.

items.name: Load the Visualizer
items.text: Costs {=effects.0.ap} AP and a spare core: the Visualizer's core is swapped for a fresh one, full.
